title: 波音CEO说产量爬坡：实际交付却砍半，差距有多大？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Yes, Kelly Orteburg is here at Farnborough, the CEO of Boeing.
segments.zh: 是的，凯利·奥特伯格在范堡罗，波音公司的CEO。

segments.en: Great to see you. Good to see you. Thanks for taking the time.
segments.zh: 很高兴见到你。谢谢抽出时间。

segments.en: Look, Kelly, you're two years in. Nearly two years in. Yeah.
segments.zh: 凯利，你上任快两年了。

segments.en: ACO of Boeing. Company feels like it's in much better shape.
segments.zh: 波音CEO。公司状况好多了。

segments.en: The share price is well off its lows. You take the whole load of boxes.
segments.zh: 股价远高于低点，你承担了很多责任。

segments.en: At the priorities beginning to change, it feels like a company that's shifting to offense, to getting on the front foot.
segments.zh: 优先级开始变化，公司转向进攻，主动出击。

segments.en: Well, we're turning the corner. I tell my team, we haven't quite finished turning the corner.
segments.zh: 我们正在好转。我告诉团队，还没完全好转。

segments.en: We've got more work to do, but I am pleased with the progress so far.
segments.zh: 还有更多工作要做，但我对进展感到满意。

segments.en: We're ramping up production across many of our product lines.
segments.zh: 我们正在多个产品线上提高产量。

segments.en: Markets are very strong. Our backlog is very, very strong.
segments.zh: 市场非常强劲，我们的订单积压非常强劲。

segments.en: So our story is really focusing on executing that backlog.
segments.zh: 所以我们的重点就是执行这些积压订单。

segments.en: Okay. The administration, the White House, has given you massive support over the last 18 months.
segments.zh: 过去18个月，白宫给了你们大力支持。

segments.en: The president certainly had your back.
segments.zh: 总统肯定支持你们。

segments.en: Do you think the company would be where it is now?
segments.zh: 您认为没有这种支持，公司还能有今天的进展吗？

segments.en: That kind of progress that you've made without that kind of support.
segments.zh: 那种支持带来的进步。

segments.en: Well, I think the execution focus is really on us to go improve our overall performance.
segments.zh: 我认为执行力的提升主要靠我们自己改善整体表现。

segments.en: Build trust with our stakeholders, restore trust with the regulator.
segments.zh: 与利益相关者建立信任，恢复监管机构的信任。

segments.en: And I think that's more what Boeing has done for themselves.
segments.zh: 这更多是波音自己做到的。

segments.en: The president has been very helpful in sales campaigns.
segments.zh: 总统在销售活动中帮了大忙。

segments.en: Balancing trade, the best way to do that is by a bunch of airplanes.
segments.zh: 平衡贸易的最佳方式就是卖出大量飞机。

segments.en: And so we've been a beneficiary of that. He's been very helpful to the whole aerospace industry.
segments.zh: 因此我们从中受益，他对整个航空业帮助很大。

segments.en: So you're in a good place right now. So what's now?
segments.zh: 所以你们现在处境不错。接下来呢？
